pattern: DocETL decomposition + gleaning (Shankar et al., PVLDB 2025, CC BY 4.0) - re-implemented as deterministic machinery; see scripts/wiki_compile_decompose.py for what is machinery and what remains an operator/model act.

paper: List every section heading of the source that the compiled page does not carry, in source order.
List every claim-level citation marker in the source whose target does not appear in the compiled page.
List every cross-reference (wikilink or named entity) in the source that the compiled page never mentions.
List every dated or numbered fact in the source that does not appear, in any form, in the compiled page.
List every caveat, condition or scope limit stated in the source that the compiled page drops.
repo: List every top-level module or directory the source describes that the compiled page does not name.
List every citation marker in the source whose target does not appear in the compiled page.
List every component named in the source that the compiled page never mentions.
List every version, count or dated fact in the source missing from the compiled page.
List every stated limitation or known gap in the source that the compiled page drops.
transcript: List every topic heading in the transcript that the compiled page does not carry.
List every citation marker in the transcript whose target does not appear in the compiled page.
List every speaker or participant named in the transcript that the compiled page never mentions.
List every decision, date or number stated in the transcript missing from the compiled page.
List every qualification or disagreement stated in the transcript that the compiled page smooths over.
filing: List every section of the filing that the compiled page does not carry.
List every citation marker in the filing whose target does not appear in the compiled page.
List every proposal or request in the filing that the compiled page never mentions.
List every dated or numbered claim in the filing missing from the compiled page.
List every caveat or dissent in the filing that the compiled page drops.
generic: List every section heading of the source that the compiled page does not carry, in source order.
List every citation marker in the source whose target does not appear in the compiled page.
List every cross-reference in the source that the compiled page never mentions.
List every dated or numbered fact in the source missing from the compiled page.
List every caveat, condition or scope limit in the source that the compiled page drops.
